Question
========
You are using a RAID 5 of 3 disks and one of the disks has been lost. Recover the C disk from the following stripes, where (P) marks the parity block of the stripe.

| A | B | C |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 | ? (P) |
| 1 (P) | 0 | ? |
| 0 | 0 (P) | ? |
| 1 | 1 | ? (P) |

What is the content of C, from the first stripe to the last?


Answerlist
----------
* 1100
* 1000
* 0110
* 1101

Solution
========
Stripe 1: C is parity, 1 xor 0 = 1. Stripe 2: A is parity, so C = A xor B = 1 xor 0 = 1. Stripe 3: B is parity, so C = A xor B = 0 xor 0 = 0. Stripe 4: C is parity, 1 xor 1 = 0.

Answerlist
----------
* 1. Parity, then reconstruction, then reconstruction, then parity: 1, 1, 0, 0.
* 0. Check stripe 2: with A as parity, C = A xor B = 1.
* 0. Check stripe 1: C is the parity of 1 and 0.
* 0. Check stripe 4: C is the parity of 1 and 1.
